CREATE PROCEDURE GetSupervisorHierarchy
    @supervisorID int,
    @languagePref nvarchar(50)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @cacheExpirationTime datetime = DATEADD(minute, 5, GETDATE());
        DECLARE @translationResult table (name nvarchar(max), address nvarchar(max));
        
        -- Retrieve supervisor information from Employees and Supervisors tables
        SELECT 
            e.name,
            d.departmentName,
            a.address,
            c.city,
            s.supervisorID,
            sl.name AS supervisorName
        INTO #supervisorHierarchy
        FROM 
            Employees e
        INNER JOIN Supervisors s ON e.employeeID = s.employeeID
        LEFT JOIN Departments d ON e.departmentID = d.departmentID
        LEFT JOIN Addresses a ON e.addressID = a.addressID
        LEFT JOIN Cities c ON a.cityID = c.cityID;

        -- Retrieve department hierarchy and employee information from Employees and Departments tables
        SELECT 
            d.departmentName,
            ed.employeeName,
            ed.email,
            e.hireDate
        INTO #departmentHierarchy
        FROM 
            Employees e
        INNER JOIN Departments d ON e.departmentID = d.departmentID
        CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 employeeName, email FROM Employees WHERE departmentID = e.departmentID ORDER BY hireDate DESC) AS ed;

        -- Update real-time data within the caching layer
        UPDATE #supervisorHierarchy
        SET name = (SELECT name FROM @translationResult WHERE supervisorID = @supervisorID),
            address = (SELECT address FROM @translationResult WHERE supervisorID = @supervisorID);

        -- Retrieve supervisor hierarchical information from the cached result
        SELECT 
            sh.name,
            d.departmentName,
            a.address,
            c.city,
            e.hireDate
        FROM 
            #supervisorHierarchy sh
        LEFT JOIN #departmentHierarchy dh ON sh.supervisorID = dh.employeeID;

        -- Commit transaction and log success
        COMMIT;
        RAISERROR('Supervisor hierarchy retrieved successfully.', 0, 1);

    BEGIN CATCH

END
